reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis correctly draws on well-established principles that a uniform distribution of oxide-forming elements (Al, Cr, Si) promotes protective oxide layers in high-temperature alloys, making it scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: A clear set of experiments is proposed (homogenized vs. deliberately segregated samples, high-temperature oxidation, and quantitative characterization) with a decisive falsification criterion.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses a key mechanism of oxidation resistance in MPEAs and outlines a practical test, providing valuable guidance to researchers working on high-temperature alloy design.
